capture_contract.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 with Max-Q Design

art_direction_target.intent: Layered rolling terrain with an eroded ravine and readable undercut, without manufactured silhouettes.
Clearly authored platform, retaining wall, supported span, and opening that remain volumetric rather than mesh-like decoration.
Overlapping blast damage and a breached constructed volume with continuous crater interiors and readable surviving structure.
A deliberately difficult but resolvable 0.25 m fixture exposing tangency, thin construction, narrow excavation, high curvature, and cast-shadow behavior.
